'''Simon Francis Thrush''' [[Royal Society of New Zealand|FRSNZ]] (born 10 November 1958) is a [[New Zealand]] marine scientist and the former Director of the Institute of Marine Science at the [[University of Auckland]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Professor Simon Francis Thrush|url=http://www.marine.auckland.ac.nz/people/simon-thrush|website=[[University of Auckland]]|access-date=2 October 2014}}</ref>

He graduated from the [[University of Otago]] with a first class BSc in Zoology in 1980, and completed his PhD at the [[University of East Anglia]] in 1985.<ref>{{cite web|title=Niwa scientist receives marine science award|url=http://tvnz.co.nz/national-news/niwa-scientist-receives-marine-science-award-3645874|website=[[One News (New Zealand)]]|access-date=2 October 2014}}</ref> He is a Fellow of the [[Royal Society of New Zealand]], and in 2010 was awarded the New Zealand Marine Sciences Life Time Achievement Award.<ref>{{cite web|title=Simon Thrush|url=http://www.royalsociety.org.nz/organisation/academy/fellowship/current-fellows/?f=22238-simon-thrush|website=[[Royal Society of New Zealand]]|access-date=2 October 2014}}</ref>
